<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Arthur M. Pasiolan — Architectural Portfolio 2026</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@200;300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --cream:#f5f2ec;--ink:#141210;--warm:#b8a07a;
  --warm2:#d4bc96;--mid:#7a746c;--light:#e2ddd6;
  --dark:#1a1714;--white:#fdfbf8;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden}
::selection{background:var(--warm);color:#fff}

/* ── NAV ── */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:20px 48px;
  transition:background .4s,padding .3s,box-shadow .3s;
}
nav.solid{
  background:rgba(245,242,236,.96);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  padding:13px 48px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--light);
}
.nav-logo{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:16px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:transparent;text-decoration:none;transition:color .4s;pointer-events:none;
}
nav.solid .nav-logo{color:var(--ink);pointer-events:all}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:0;list-style:none;align-items:center}
.nav-links li a{
  display:block;padding:8px 12px;
  font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:400;
  color:rgba(253,251,248,.6);text-decoration:none;
  transition:color .25s,background .25s;border-radius:2px;
}
.nav-links li a:hover{color:var(--warm2)}
nav.solid .nav-links li a{color:var(--mid)}
nav.solid .nav-links li a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links li a.active{color:var(--warm)!important;font-weight:500}

/* hamburger */
.hamburger{
  display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;
  cursor:pointer;padding:6px;background:none;border:none;z-index:210;
}
.hamburger span{
  display:block;width:24px;height:1.5px;
  background:var(--white);border-radius:2px;transition:all .3s;
}
nav.solid .hamburger span{background:var(--ink)}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* mobile drawer */
.nav-drawer{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,18,16,.97);
  z-index:190;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s;
}
.nav-drawer.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.nav-drawer a{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:30px;font-weight:300;
  color:rgba(253,251,248,.65);text-decoration:none;padding:10px 0;transition:color .2s;
}
.nav-drawer a:hover{color:var(--warm2)}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{height:100vh;min-height:500px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  transform:scale(1.04);transition:transform 9s ease;
}
.hero-bg.loaded{transform:scale(1)}
.hero-vignette{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 45%,rgba(10,9,8,.45) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-fade{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:150px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,var(--cream));
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ── SCROLL CUE ── */
.scroll-cue{
  position:absolute;bottom:44px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  z-index:10;opacity:0;animation:fadeIn 1s 1.2s forwards;
  cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
}
.scroll-cue-text{
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font-weight:400;
  text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.9);white-space:nowrap;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;
}
.scroll-arrow{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0;
  animation:bounce 1.8s infinite;
}
.scroll-arrow span{
  display:block;width:10px;height:10px;
  border-right:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  transform:rotate(45deg);margin-top:-5px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.7));
}
.scroll-arrow span:nth-child(1){opacity:.3}
.scroll-arrow span:nth-child(2){opacity:.65}
.scroll-arrow span:nth-child(3){opacity:1}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}

/* ── SLIDES ── */
.slide-block{
  position:relative;background:var(--dark);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
.slide-block img{width:100%;display:block;transition:filter .4s;cursor:zoom-in}
.slide-block:hover img{filter:brightness(.9)}
.slide-num{
  position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;
  font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px;
}

/* ── SECTION BANNER ── */
.proj-banner{
  min-height:58px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:var(--dark);padding:12px 48px;
  border-top:2px solid var(--warm);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;
}
.proj-banner-num{
  font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--warm);margin-right:18px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:400;
}
.proj-banner-title{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:24px;font-weight:300;color:var(--white);white-space:nowrap;
}
.proj-banner-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--warm2)}
.proj-banner-sub{
  margin-left:auto;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:rgba(253,251,248,.28);text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;
}

/* ── SEPARATOR ── */
.sep{height:3px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--warm),transparent 55%)}

/* ── LIGHTBOX ── */
.lightbox{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;background:rgba(10,9,8,.96);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
.lightbox.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.lightbox img{
  max-width:92vw;max-height:88vh;object-fit:contain;
  box-shadow:0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7);cursor:zoom-out;touch-action:pinch-zoom;
}
.lb-close{
  position:fixed;top:16px;right:16px;
  background:rgba(20,18,16,.8);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;transition:all .2s;border-radius:2px;
}
.lb-close:hover{background:var(--warm);border-color:var(--warm);color:#fff}
.lb-nav{
  position:fixed;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:44px;height:44px;background:rgba(20,18,16,.75);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:18px;transition:all .2s;border-radius:2px;
}
.lb-nav:hover{background:var(--warm);border-color:var(--warm);color:#fff}
.lb-prev{left:12px}.lb-next{right:12px}
.lb-counter{
  position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:10px;
}

/* ── READING BAR ── */
.reading-bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;background:var(--warm);z-index:300;width:0%;transition:width .1s linear}

/* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
@keyframes fadeIn{to{opacity:1}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.r1{transition-delay:.1s}.r2{transition-delay:.2s}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:768px){
  nav{padding:14px 20px}nav.solid{padding:11px 20px}
  .nav-links{display:none}.hamburger{display:flex}
  .proj-banner{padding:10px 20px;min-height:52px}
  .proj-banner-num{font-size:8px;margin-right:10px}
  .proj-banner-title{font-size:19px}
  .proj-banner-sub{display:none}
  .scroll-cue{bottom:56px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .proj-banner-title{font-size:16px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="reading-bar" id="readingBar"></div>

<!-- MOBILE DRAWER -->
<div class="nav-drawer" id="navDrawer">
  <a href="#toc" onclick="closeDrawer()">Contents</a>
  <a href="#themis" onclick="closeDrawer()">THEMIS</a>
  <a href="#sumulong" onclick="closeDrawer()">Sumulong Transit</a>
  <a href="#professional" onclick="closeDrawer()">Residential</a>
  <a href="#ojt" onclick="closeDrawer()">OJT Renders</a>
  <a href="#about" onclick="closeDrawer()">About</a>
  <a href="#contact" onclick="closeDrawer()">Contact</a>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="nav">
  <a class="nav-logo" href="#hero">Arthur M. Pasiolan</a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#toc" id="nav-toc">Contents</a></li>
    <li><a href="#themis" id="nav-themis">THEMIS</a></li>
    <li><a href="#sumulong" id="nav-sumulong">Sumulong</a></li>
    <li><a href="#professional" id="nav-professional">Residential</a></li>
    <li><a href="#ojt" id="nav-ojt">OJT</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about" id="nav-about">About</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contact" id="nav-contact">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
  <button class="hamburger" id="hamburger" onclick="toggleDrawer()" aria-label="Menu">
    <span></span><span></span><span></span>
  </button>
</nav>

<!-- ══ HERO — page 2 (Arthur M. Pasiolan cover) ══ -->
<section id="hero" class="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg" id="heroBg"></div>
  <div class="hero-vignette"></div>
  <div class="hero-fade"></div>
  <a class="scroll-cue" href="#toc" id="scrollCue">
    <div class="scroll-cue-text">Scroll to explore</div>
    <div class="scroll-arrow"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </a>
</section>

<!-- ══ TOC ══ -->
<section id="toc">
  <div class="slide-block reveal">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Table of Contents" onclick="openLightbox(3)">
    <span class="slide-num">01</span>
  </div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ THEMIS ══ -->
<section id="themis">
  <div class="proj-banner">
    <span class="proj-banner-num">01 — THESIS · DESIGN 10</span>
    <span class="proj-banner-title">THE<em>MIS</em></span>
    <span class="proj-banner-sub">Redevelopment of Caloocan City Jail &nbsp;·&nbsp; BJMP &nbsp;·&nbsp; Dec 2025</span>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="THEMIS" onclick="openLightbox(4)"><span class="slide-num">02</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="THEMIS Introduction" onclick="openLightbox(5)"><span class="slide-num">03</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="THEMIS Site Analysis" onclick="openLightbox(6)"><span class="slide-num">04</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="THEMIS Elevations" onclick="openLightbox(7)"><span class="slide-num">05</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="THEMIS Renders" onclick="openLightbox(8)"><span class="slide-num">06</span></div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ SUMULONG ══ -->
<section id="sumulong">
  <div class="proj-banner">
    <span class="proj-banner-num">02 — ACADEMIC · DESIGN 7</span>
    <span class="proj-banner-title">Sumulong <em>Transit</em></span>
    <span class="proj-banner-sub">Proposed Bus Terminal &nbsp;·&nbsp; Taguig City &nbsp;·&nbsp; April 2022</span>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sumulong Exterior" onclick="openLightbox(9)"><span class="slide-num">07</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sumulong Divider" onclick="openLightbox(10)"><span class="slide-num">08</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sumulong Renders" onclick="openLightbox(11)"><span class="slide-num">09</span></div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ PROFESSIONAL ══ -->
<section id="professional">
  <div class="proj-banner">
    <span class="proj-banner-num">03 — PROFESSIONAL WORKS</span>
    <span class="proj-banner-title">Residential <em>Projects</em></span>
    <span class="proj-banner-sub">Under Ar. Ramon R. De Guzman &nbsp;·&nbsp; 2023</span>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Residential Divider" onclick="openLightbox(12)"><span class="slide-num">10</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="2nd Floor Addition" onclick="openLightbox(13)"><span class="slide-num">11</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Kitchen and Bedroom" onclick="openLightbox(14)"><span class="slide-num">12</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Tagaytay Residence" onclick="openLightbox(15)"><span class="slide-num">13</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Tagaytay Perspectives" onclick="openLightbox(16)"><span class="slide-num">14</span></div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ OJT ══ -->
<section id="ojt">
  <div class="proj-banner">
    <span class="proj-banner-num">04 — OJT RENDERING WORKS</span>
    <span class="proj-banner-title">Interior <em>Renders</em></span>
    <span class="proj-banner-sub">MA Builders &nbsp;·&nbsp; 3D Visualization &nbsp;·&nbsp; 2023</span>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OJT Divider" onclick="openLightbox(17)"><span class="slide-num">15</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="OJT Interior Renders" onclick="openLightbox(18)"><span class="slide-num">16</span></div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ ABOUT ══ -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="proj-banner">
    <span class="proj-banner-num">05 — PROFILE</span>
    <span class="proj-banner-title">About <em>Arthur</em></span>
    <span class="proj-banner-sub">Skills &nbsp;·&nbsp; Education &nbsp;·&nbsp; Background</span>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="About Arthur" onclick="openLightbox(19)"><span class="slide-num">17</span></div>
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Design guided by dignity" onclick="openLightbox(20)"><span class="slide-num">18</span></div>
</section>
<div class="sep"></div>

<!-- ══ CONTACT — using page 21 from PDF (Let's Work Together) ══ -->
<section id="contact">
  <div class="slide-block reveal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Contact" onclick="openLightbox(21)"><span class="slide-num">19</span></div>
</section>

<!-- ══ LIGHTBOX ══ -->
<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox">
  <button class="lb-close" onclick="closeLightbox()">✕ Close</button>
  <button class="lb-nav lb-prev" onclick="lbNav(-1)">&#8592;</button>
  <img id="lbImg" src="" alt="">
  <button class="lb-nav lb-next" onclick="lbNav(1)">&#8594;</button>
  <div class="lb-counter" id="lbCounter"></div>
</div>

<script>
const SLIDES = {"3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "4": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "5": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "6": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "7": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "8": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "9": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "10": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "11": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "12": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "13": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "14": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "15": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "16": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "17": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "18": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "19": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "20": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "21": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
const KEYS = Object.keys(SLIDES).map(Number).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
let lbCurrent = 3;

function openLightbox(n){
  lbCurrent = n;
  document.getElementById('lbImg').src = SLIDES[n];
  document.getElementById('lbCounter').textContent = (KEYS.indexOf(n)+1) + ' / ' + KEYS.length;
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeLightbox(){
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
function lbNav(dir){
  const idx = KEYS.indexOf(lbCurrent);
  const next = KEYS[Math.max(0, Math.min(KEYS.length-1, idx+dir))];
  lbCurrent = next;
  document.getElementById('lbImg').src = SLIDES[next];
  document.getElementById('lbCounter').textContent = (KEYS.indexOf(next)+1) + ' / ' + KEYS.length;
}
// swipe in lightbox
let lbTX = 0;
document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('touchstart', e=>{lbTX=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('touchend', e=>{
  const d = lbTX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
  if(Math.abs(d)>40) lbNav(d>0?1:-1);
});
document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('click', e=>{
  if(e.target===document.getElementById('lightbox')) closeLightbox();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  if(!document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.contains('open')) return;
  if(e.key==='Escape') closeLightbox();
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight') lbNav(1);
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft') lbNav(-1);
});

// hamburger
function toggleDrawer(){
  document.getElementById('navDrawer').classList.toggle('open');
  document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.toggle('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = document.getElementById('navDrawer').classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
}
function closeDrawer(){
  document.getElementById('navDrawer').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

// hero bg = page 2 (cover with name)
const heroBg = document.getElementById('heroBg');
heroBg.style.backgroundImage = `url("data:image/jpeg;base64,")`;
setTimeout(()=>heroBg.classList.add('loaded'), 80);

// nav + scroll
const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
const bar = document.getElementById('readingBar');
window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
  const scrolled = window.scrollY;
  const total = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
  bar.style.width = (scrolled/total*100) + '%';
  nav.classList.toggle('solid', scrolled > window.innerHeight * 0.82);
  ['toc','themis','sumulong','professional','ojt','about','contact'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const link = document.getElementById('nav-'+id);
    if(link) link.classList.toggle('active', rect.top<=80 && rect.bottom>80);
  });
});

// scroll reveal
const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');obs.unobserve(e.target);}
  });
},{threshold:0.04,rootMargin:'0px 0px -20px 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
</script>
</body>
</html>
